featured.title: EventPass
featured.pitch: QR-code check-in for student clubs. Students get a ticket, organizers scan it at the door from a phone, and every ticket checks in exactly once, even when several organizers scan at the same moment.
featured.detail: 2,862 concurrent scans, ~950 req/s on one worker after I found and fixed a deadlock, 97% test coverage

featured.title: Satellite SRGAN
featured.pitch: A super-resolution GAN that sharpens satellite images 4×, trained in two stages: MSE pre-training, then adversarial fine-tuning with a VGG19 perceptual loss.
featured.detail: 34.55 dB PSNR and 0.08 LPIPS in the paper

featured.title: SnapInterview
featured.pitch: Practice technical interviews out loud. An LLM interviewer listens, asks adaptive follow-ups and scores the answers you actually gave.

featured.title: RAG project
